info.name: FoodExpress - Restaurants, Dishes and Orders
info.description: Run `npm run seed` first, then run the whole collection in order (Runner). It covers the public routes, role/ownership checks, order rules and the full pizza scenario. Data it creates is cleaned in the last folder, but orders stay: re-run `npm run seed` before the demo.

exec: pm.test("finds Dar Pizza", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(r => r.nom)).to.include("Dar Pizza"));

exec: pm.test("price and availability changed", () => { pm.expect(d.prix).to.eql(7.5); pm.expect(d.disponible).to.eql(false); });

item.name: O1 Create order (client): server computes totals

exec: pm.test("totals computed by server", () => { pm.expect(o.sousTotal).to.eql(26.5); pm.expect(o.fraisLivraison).to.eql(3); pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(29.5); });
pm.test("lines copy name and price", () => { const l = o.articles.find(a => a.nom === "Pizza Margherita"); pm.expect(l.prixUnitaire).to.eql(12); pm.expect(l.quantite).to.eql(2); });

item.name: O2 Tampered total and prices are ignored

exec: pm.test("total still computed from database prices", () => pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(29.5));
pm.test("unit price from database", () => pm.expect(o.articles.find(a => a.nom === "Pizza Margherita").prixUnitaire).to.eql(12));
